2.note: A deliberately INCONSISTENT pair, for CharacterFactory.requireSummonable: this rule summons a memosprite for whoever wears the set, and the wearer in the test (姬子 1003) has no memosprite spec. It is a RELIC rule rather than a character rule on purpose -- that is the harder half of the check, since a relic rule is shared by every wearer and its cid is unknown until assembly. ⚠ Set 113's 2-piece is stats-only (CriticalChanceBase, no named ability) and 108/2 is neither registered nor authored, so this file cannot disturb RelicTriggerTableTest's partition: that test only looks at ability-bearing effects, and the set's own ability lives at 108/4 (registered, and still without a file). ⚠ It used to hang off set 103 -- moved on 2026-09-28, the day 103 became real shipped content (「使装备者提供的护盾量提高20%」): a test fixture in src/test/resources SHADOWS the shipped file of the same name on the classpath, so a fixture parked on a set that later ships silently replaces it and the author sees 'not authored and not forgotten must not look the same' instead of their own bug. A character-rule fixture would have been worse: SkillSlotMappingTest and UltraThresholdTest build EVERY character, so a fixture for any cid that exists in the data breaks those sweeps (tried it). ⚠⚠ **2026-09-29（第二次迁移）**：`RelicFactory.suit` 校验编号**必须存在于 `relic_sets.json`**，所以 `9xxx` 不可用；现停在 **`119`** —— 它**存在于数据中**、**2 件套只有常数属性**、且**尚无出货文件**。⭐ **它一旦出货，本夹具就会把出货文件遮住**（第 103、113 两次教训）⇒ 那时**必须再迁一次**。
